notes.title: Ghosts, Questions, and a Little Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again,[/p][p]This one’s short but spooky 👻[/p][p][i]A Story of Questions[/i] is now part of the [b]Hungry Ghost Festival[/b] on Steam!
It’s a special event highlighting haunting, atmospheric horror games, so if you’ve been thinking about wishlisting, now’s a perfect time.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="F_T6DPRoCJ8;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]A Quiet Month…[/h3][p]You may have noticed it’s been a little quiet around here. That’s because I’ve been working away on something special for the game. I can’t share details just yet, but let’s just say it’s bigger than a plush duck this time 😉[/p][p][/p][p]Every Choice Still Matters[/p][p]In case you’re new here:
[i]A Story of Questions[/i] is a narrative-driven horror mystery about choices.
Small ones, like opening a box or playing a tape.
Bigger ones, like answering a question that may change everything.
Every choice closes a door… and opens another.#[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s Next?[/b][/p][p]For now, I’ll keep building in the background, but I wanted to drop by, share the event, and say thank you for sticking with me even when things get quiet.[/p][p]Your support (and wishlists) mean the world 💛[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/TheHungryGhostFestival2025" buttoncolor="#3691fa"]👉 [/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/TheHungryGhostFestival2025"]The Hungry Ghost Festival Event Link[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]- Tim[/p][p]Under the Bridge Games[/p]

notes.title: “A Story of Questions” is part of Games Forged in Germany! 🇩🇪
notes.notes:
[p]We're thrilled to share that [i]A Story of Questions[/i] is featured in the [b]Games Forged in Germany[/b] event.[/p][p]This special showcase highlights unique and creative games developed in Germany and as a solo dev, I’m incredibly proud to be part of it.[/p][p]If you're discovering the game for the first time:
[i]A Story of Questions[/i] is a narrative-driven horror mystery where every choice matters. You're stuck at a desk. The lights flicker. The ducks are watching. And all you can do… is answer.[/p][p]🔍 Explore strange objects.
🖱️ Interact with your environment in ways you might not expect.
🦆 And yes… there are ducks. If you make the right decisions.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="F_T6DPRoCJ8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
📝 Add the game to your wishlist,
💬 Or drop by the comments and let me know what you’d do if [i]your[/i] only way forward was to answer a question.[/p][p]👉 Don’t forget to check out the full Games Forged in Germany lineup too  there are some fantastic titles in there! [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]Games Forged in Germany Event Link[/url][/p][p]Thank you so much for the support and welcome to everyone who found the game through the event![/p][p]🖤
- Tim (Under the Bridge Games)[/p]

notes.title: Of Duckies and Bottles
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again,[/p][p]Here’s my first little dev update, this one’s got leaks, fluff, and a few strange consequences…[/p][p][/p][h1]Bottle Trouble[/h1][p][/p][p]I’ve been working on adding more interactable objects, and in this case, that means bottles.
In the latest test, a water bottle falls, spills across the table, and even dries up over time. It’s all done with a super light flipbook system, so it looks cool and barely affects performance.[/p][p]It still clips through the coffee cup (yes, I see it 👀), but hey, one bug at a time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651717/837642bf860a9131ff102c2942d72fd2540609cd.gif"][/img][/p][h1]Mr. Quack Is Watching[/h1][p][/p][p]Also new: a mysterious plush duck has joined development. His name is Mr. Quack, and yes, he’s a little too fluffy (thanks to parallax occlusion).[/p][p]Depending on your choices, he might change color.
Stare at him too long, though… and weird stuff happens.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651717/9e3a33e7ce07c889179d650363088d02d2bb7aeb.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]What's Next?[/h1][p][/p][p]Right now, I’m focusing on finishing the main story, so yes, Mr. Quack is a bit of a detour 😉[/p][p]but overall, development is moving along nicely.[/p][p][/p][h1]Let’s Chat![/h1][p][/p][p]Have a favorite part of this update? Want more behind-the-scenes stuff (like how I made the spill effect or will there be cake)? Let me know in the comments, I love hearing what you're curious about.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being here 💛[/p][p]- Tim[/p][p][i]Under the Bridge Games[/i][/p]

notes.title: Hey everyone, and welcome to A Story of Questions!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]This is the very first time I'm sharing this project publicly, so if you haven’t heard of it before, that’s because it’s brand new. I’m incredibly excited (and a bit nervous) to finally show what I’ve been quietly working on.[/p][p][i]A Story of Questions[/i] just made its debut at the Deutsche Indie Games Showcase, and with it, the official announcement trailer is now live! You can watch it below [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="F_T6DPRoCJ8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Before anything else, I want to say a huge thank you to the Deutsche Indie Showcase and 1UP Management team for including my game, and also to Gronkh and PhunkRoyal for highlighting it during the stream. As a solo developer, that kind of support means the world and helped introduce [i]A Story of Questions[/i] to so many new eyes. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p][b]So, what’s the game about?[/b][/p][p]It’s a single-player, narrative-driven horror mystery.
You're trapped, unable to walk, with only a desk in front of you.
A woman speaks to you through a speaker.
You’ll solve puzzles, explore your limited surroundings, and make meaningful, often unsettling choices.
The story that unfolds is strange, supernatural and disturbing.[/p][p]This is a slow, atmospheric experience with point-and-click elements, psychological tension, and a focus on story above all else.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s still a long road ahead, but development is well underway. If the game speaks to you, please consider adding it to your wishlist - it really helps with visibility and support:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3598450/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, and welcome aboard.[/p][p]- Tim
[i]Under the Bridge Games[/i][/p]
